#!BAT!
@echo off
${a} = 0
set batcont on
log preserve on
close all
set wait 1000
cls
echo "arg = " + ${%%ARGS%%}
echo "a0-1"
wait
IF (${a} == 0) (
  echo "a0-2"
  wait
  bat exec IyFCQVQhDQplY2hvICJhMSBhcmcgPSAiICsgJHslJUFSR1MlJX0NCmVjaG8gImExLTEiDQojenp6DQpJRiAoJHslJUFSR1MlJX1bMV0gPT0gImZyb21BMCBBIikgKA0KICBsb2NhdGlvbi5ocmVmID0gJ2luZGV4Lmh0bWwnDQopDQp3YWl0DQplY2hvICJhMS0yIg0Kd2FpdA0KI2V4aXQgMg0KZWNobyAiYTEtMyINCndhaXQNCg== "fromA0 A"
  echo "EXIT CODE = " + ${?}
  IF (${?} != 0) (
    echo "ERROR!!!"
  ) ELSE (
    echo "OK!!!"
  )
) ELSE (
  echo "a0-3"
  wait
  bat exec  "fromA0 B"
)
echo "a0 arg = " + ${%%ARGS%%}
echo "a0-4"
wait
echo "a0-5"
echo "End of BAT"
log preserve off
